nodes.description: msg.sender - caller address that selects the player slot, indexes playerVault and receives withdrawals
uint256 Refundpot - pool funding 0.1 ether refunds for losers in the waiting line
uint256 Jackpot - accumulated 1% of P3D dividends paid out on a 1/1000 blockhash roll
uint256 SPASMfee - declared fee share for SPASM holders, never assigned in this code
mapping(address=>uint256) ETH queued per masternode to purchase P3D
uint256 winningsPerRound = 0.185 ether credited to each surviving player
mapping(address=>string) Vanity - user chosen display names written by changevanity
mapping(address=>uint256) playerVault - internal earnings balance credited and withdrawn per player
mapping(uint256=>Stage) stages - per-round players, blocknumber and finalization flag
mapping(uint256=>address) RefundWaitingLine - FIFO queue of sacrificed players awaiting refund
mapping(uint256=>address) Loser - recorded sacrifice for each finalized stage
uint256 NextInLine - head pointer of the refund queue, incremented on every payout
uint256 NextAtLineEnd - tail pointer of the refund queue, incremented on every loss
uint256 numberOfFinalizedStages - counter of finalized/invalidated stages
uint256 numberOfStages - counter of created stages

public view returning true when a stage is ready to be validated
